title: The Wildflower Honey Jar
scene: Between 11:10 and 11:30 AM, the wildflower honey jar vanished from the tasting shed. The barn is too small for a second person to hide.

suspects.name: Ruth Dawson
suspects.testimony: I bottled beeswax balm in the barn from 11:05 to 11:35 AM, completely alone the whole time.
suspects.alibiProof: The barn door chime stayed silent, and Anita's view through the doorway confirms Ruth was alone.

suspects.name: Anita Gomez
suspects.testimony: I weeded lavender beds facing the open barn door from 11:05 to 11:35 AM; only Ruth was inside.
suspects.alibiProof: Two farm visitors asked Anita about lavender care outside the barn from 11:05 to 11:35 AM.

suspects.name: Leonard Perry
suspects.testimony: I fixed a loose shutter right beside the tasting shed from 11:10 to 11:30 AM.
suspects.alibiProof: The farm dog and two delivery helpers watched Leonard hammering by the shed from 11:10 to 11:30 AM.

suspects.name: Desmond Curry
suspects.testimony: I was in the barn with Ruth from 11:05 to 11:35 AM, helping her seal the balm tins.
suspects.contradiction: Anita saw Ruth alone in the barn, and the honey jar was tucked inside Desmond's coat.
